_comment: Deploy targets — one row per (tenant × stage). Each row maps to a GitHub Environment named `<tenant>-<stage>` (repo → Settings → Environments) that holds THAT stack's deploy vars (DEPLOY_PROJECT, ARTIFACT_REGISTRY, GCP_REGION, GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER, GCP_CI_SERVICE_ACCOUNT, NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_ID, NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_SERVER_CONTAINER_URL). The deploy workflow reads NO tenant/stage-specific value itself — it fans out over these rows. Add a target = add a row here, add infra/tenants/<tenant>/env/<stage>.tfvars, and create the Environment. No workflow edit.
_trigger: trigger=push → auto-deploys on merge to main (and on a blank workflow_dispatch). trigger=manual → workflow_dispatch only. Gating (prod/uat) is orthogonal: set required reviewers on the GitHub Environment to make ANY run pause for approval, regardless of trigger.
_stages: Stages live today: sbx. Planned: dev, uat, prod — add each as a new row + Environment + tfvars when its GCP project is provisioned.
